source: Federal Elections Analysis direct poll-release ledger
instructions: Add one object per public pollster release. Required: office, pollster, url (or sourceUrl), endDate, plus state for Senate/Governor or district (for example IA-01) for House. Use candidates with name, party, and pct. The legacy dem/rep fields remain supported. Optional: startDate, sampleSize, population (LV, RV, or adults), sponsor, partisan, internal, source, weight. Candidate matches are classified EXACT, ALIAS, PARTY_GENERIC, LOW_CONFIDENCE, or FAILED; low-confidence rows are excluded until corrected. Rows are deduplicated by pollster, scope, date, sample, and candidate pairing.
